BREAKING: Gerardo Navarro was arrested in Webb County on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, on a third-degree felony charge of unlawful possession of a firearm by a felon, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search.

Navarro was arrested at 4:08 p.m. The booking record also lists two misdemeanor charges: discharge of a firearm in certain municipalities, a Class A misdemeanor, and driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor.

No bond had been set at the time of booking.

The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

An arrest is an accusation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Update — October 30, 2026: In the related felony case 2026CRO000893D1 (49th District Court), court records show that at a status hearing on October 29, 2026, Navarro pleaded guilty to Count I, unlawful possession of a firearm by a felon, and was sentenced to serve three years in the Texas Department of Criminal Justice with credit for time served; Count II, discharge of a firearm in certain municipalities, was dismissed, and court costs of $330 were assessed, according to the Webb County public-access court records. No future hearing is shown in that case detail. The felony-case notes also state that the related misdemeanor DWI case 2026CRB000210L1 was dismissed under Texas Penal Code 12.45 as part of the plea agreement; however, that misdemeanor case's own portal entry still shows it as active, with a next arraignment listed for November 2, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. before Judge Hugo D. Martinez. Webb Watch 956 reports both portal entries as shown and has not resolved the discrepancy.

Sources:

  • Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search
  • Webb County public-access court records
  • Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal (Oct. 30, 2026 check: Oct. 29, 2026 status hearing, guilty plea and sentence, case 2026CRO000893D1; DWI case 2026CRB000210L1 still shown active with Nov. 2, 2026 arraignment)
